note: The drone light show over 云海湾 (src/world/drones.js). It starts at each hour in `times` (game clock; `end` is the key of the line that closes that show) and runs on real seconds: `launch` on the barge with the lights on, `rise` to the first formation, then `hold` and `move` for each one, and `land` back at the barge. A game hour is 60 real seconds, so a show (about 150 s) ends well before the next one. Text formations rasterise `text` (a signs.json entry: looking at it names the phrase); a text with `wrap` breaks into lines of at most that many characters; shape formations draw `main` and `accent` strokes in a 200 x 120 design space (y down; `line` is straight, `curve` is smoothed) and are named by `look` (an objects.json key). The `accent` drones take the second colour: the blue wisps under the boat, the lotus leaf.
speaker: narrator
